rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for doing or saying something in an emotional, sentimental way.

example.english: They spoke sentimentally about their old classmates.
example.traditional: 佢感性咁講起以前嗰班老同學。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gam2 sing3 gam3 gong2 hei2 ji5 cin4 go2 baan1 lou5 tung4 hok6

rows.note: Use this when the sentimental behaviour especially suggests letting emotion override reason.

example.english: They sentimentally pleaded for their friend, leaving no one to take responsibility.
example.traditional: 佢感情用事咁幫個朋友求情，搞到成件事冇人負責。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gam2 cing4 jung6 si6 gam3 bong1 go3 pang4 jau5 kau4 cing4 gaau2 dou3 sing4 gin6 si6 mou5 jan4 fu6 zaak3
